name: stripe-integration
title: Stripe Integration (Umbraco Commerce)
description: The Stripe sequence for Umbraco Commerce, split across phases: a Stripe Integration Feature in the build (account, sandbox keys and webhook, test payments, client account activation) and a Stripe Go-live Feature at launch (live keys and webhook, wallet domains, live smoke test). The per-environment webhook signing secrets and starting the client's activation early are the steps that usually get missed.

variables.name: domain_name
variables.description: The site taking payments, e.g. example.com

variables.name: build_list
variables.description: Task list (project phase) for the build

tasks.title: Stripe Integration
tasks.description: Set up Stripe and prove the full payment flow in the sandbox.

subtasks.title: Create the Stripe account
subtasks.description:
Create the Stripe account in the **client's name and email**, not TSD's - they own the money and the compliance relationship. Then invite the TSD team as team members (Developer role is enough for integration work).

Store the login details in LastPass under the client's folder.

subtasks.title: Sandbox: get the test API keys
subtasks.description:
From the Stripe dashboard in **test mode**: copy the publishable key (`pk_test_...`) and secret key (`sk_test_...`).

Store both in LastPass. Never put the secret key in source control - it goes in environment config only.

subtasks.title: Sandbox: set up the webhook and capture the signing secret
subtasks.description:
In test mode, add a webhook endpoint pointing at the UAT/staging site's Umbraco Commerce Stripe callback URL.

**Gotchas that have bitten us before:**

* The signing secret (`whsec_...`) is **per endpoint** - the sandbox one will not work in live, and a second endpoint on the same account gets its own secret
* The endpoint URL must be publicly reachable - Stripe cannot call a site behind basic auth or IP restrictions, so allow the webhook path through
* Subscribe to the events Umbraco Commerce needs (at minimum `payment_intent.succeeded`, `payment_intent.payment_failed`, and the charge/refund events if refunds are handled through the site)

Store the signing secret in LastPass alongside the keys.

subtasks.title: Configure the test keys in code/CMS
subtasks.description:
Configure the Umbraco Commerce Stripe payment provider for the test environments: publishable key, secret key, webhook signing secret, and test mode ON.

Keys and webhook secrets are **per environment** - UAT and production must each hold their own set, so keep them in environment config/secrets rather than baked into the site.

subtasks.title: Test payments end-to-end in sandbox
subtasks.description: Run the full order flow on UAT with Stripe test cards (4242 4242 4242 4242 for success). The point of this task is proving the **webhook round-trip** works, not just the card form - if orders sit at pending/authorised after payment, the webhook isn't reaching the site or the signing secret is wrong.

subtasks.title: Successful payment updates the order status via webhook
Declined card shows a helpful error and leaves no phantom order
3D Secure challenge completes
subtasks.description: Use Stripe's 3DS test card (4000 0027 6000 3184) to confirm the SCA challenge flow works within the checkout.

subtasks.title: Refund from the Stripe dashboard reflects on the order
subtasks.description: Refund a test payment in Stripe and confirm the order/webhook handling reflects it (or document that refunds are dashboard-only for this client).

subtasks.title: Client completes Stripe account activation (company details)
subtasks.description:
The client must fill out their business profile before live keys are available: company details, directors/owners identity checks, bank account for payouts, and VAT number.

**Start this early** - Stripe's verification can take days and it's the usual go-live blocker. Send the client the activation link as soon as the account exists rather than waiting for dev work to finish.

subtasks.title: Set the statement descriptor and public business details
subtasks.description: In Stripe settings, check the statement descriptor is something the customer will recognise on their bank statement (usually the trading name or domain, not a company registration name) - it's the single biggest cause of chargebacks. Also check the support email/phone shown on receipts.

tasks.title: Stripe Go-live
tasks.description: Switch payments to the live Stripe account and prove a real transaction end to end.

subtasks.title: Live: get the live API keys
subtasks.description: Once activation is complete, copy the live publishable (`pk_live_...`) and secret (`sk_live_...`) keys into LastPass.

subtasks.title: Live: set up the webhook and capture the signing secret
subtasks.description: Add a **live mode** webhook endpoint pointing at https://{{domain_name}}'s Stripe callback URL, subscribed to the same events as the sandbox endpoint. Capture its own `whsec_...` signing secret - the sandbox secret will not verify live events.

subtasks.title: Configure the live keys in production
subtasks.description: Production config gets the live publishable key, live secret key, the **live** webhook signing secret, and test mode OFF. Double-check UAT still points at the test keys so nobody takes a real payment from staging.

subtasks.title: Apple Pay / Google Pay domain verification (if used)
subtasks.description: If the checkout offers wallet payments, register and verify {{domain_name}} under Stripe's payment method domains settings - wallets silently fail to appear on unverified domains.

subtasks.title: Live payment smoke test and refund
subtasks.description: Place a real low-value order on the live site with a TSD card: confirm the payment appears in the live Stripe dashboard, the order status updates via the live webhook, and the confirmation email sends. Then refund it from Stripe and confirm the refund lands.
